alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 9 at 8:47AM EDT until October 9 at 7:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...West winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves 2 to 3 feet expected. * WHERE...Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...Until 7 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
